title: ReWOO Plan & Execute
motto: ReAct interleaves thought and action in one stream. ReWOO separates them: one big plan up front, then execute. 5x fewer tokens, +4% accuracy on HotpotQA, and you can distill the planner into a 7B model. Plan-and-Execute generalized it; Plan-and-Act scaled it to web navigation.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: ReAct interleaves thought and action in one stream. ReWOO separates them: one big plan up front, then execute. 5x fewer tokens, +4% accuracy on HotpotQA, and you can distill the planner into a 7B model. Plan-and-Execute generalized it; Plan-and-Act scaled it to web navigation.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: ReAct's interleaved thought-action-observation loop is simple and flexible, but each tool call has to carry the full prior context — including every previous thought. Token usage grows quadratically with depth. Worse: when a tool fails mid-loop, the model has to re-derive the whole plan from the error observation.

ReWOO (Xu et al., arXiv:2305.18323, May 2023) noticed this and made a bet: plan the whole thing up front, fetch evidence in parallel, compose the answer at the end. One LLM call to plan, N tool calls for evidence (can be parallel), one LLM call to solve. The trade is less flexibility (the plan is static) for much better token efficiency and clearer failure modes.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Plan all tool calls upfront, then execute — reduces LLM calls.
